Meta AI lives inside WhatsApp now: ask it questions, tag it in group chats and type imagine to make pictures.
There is no off switch, but you can reset what it keeps.

Do you actually use Meta AI in WhatsApp?

threads_text: Meta AI sits inside WhatsApp whether you want it or not: there is no setting that removes it. You can tag it in groups, make images with imagine, or reset what it keeps with /reset-ai. Do you use it or ignore it?

slides.headline: How to use *Meta AI in WhatsApp*, and how to limit it

slides.heading: 1. Ask with *@Meta AI*
paras: Open the Meta AI chat, or type a question in the search bar.
In a group, type @Meta AI first. It only reads messages that mention it.

slides.heading: 2. Type *imagine*
paras: In any chat, type @ and pick imagine, or type it in the Meta AI chat.
Reply to the picture with a new prompt to change it.
slides.prompt: imagine a flat, colorful icon of [subject] for a group chat called [name]

slides.heading: 3. Go *Incognito*
paras: Incognito Chat is not saved and disappears by default, WhatsApp says.
It is still rolling out, so you may not see it yet.

slides.heading: 4. You can't *remove* it
paras: There is no off switch. You can delete its chats and mute it.
Guides say /reset-ai deletes Meta AI's copy of a chat.

site_article.headline: How to use Meta AI in WhatsApp, and how to limit it
site_article.dek: Ask questions, make images and plan with friends without leaving WhatsApp. Here is how it works, what Meta keeps and what you can switch off.
site_article.summary: Meta AI is built into WhatsApp in many countries: open its chat, ask from the search bar or type @Meta AI in a group. It cannot be removed, but you can delete or reset its chats and keep it out of sensitive conversations.

site_article.answer_summary: Open the Meta AI chat or type in the WhatsApp search bar, use @Meta AI in groups and type imagine to create images. There is no setting to remove Meta AI, but you can delete its chats, send /reset-ai and use Advanced Chat Privacy.

paragraphs.text: How to use Meta AI in WhatsApp, in short: open the Meta AI chat or type a question in the search bar, and it answers like a contact would. In a group, type @Meta AI before your question. To make a picture, type imagine followed by what you want. Meta AI is optional in WhatsApp, but there is no setting that removes it. You can mute it, reset what it remembers and keep it out of specific chats.

Meta AI is Meta's assistant built into WhatsApp. WhatsApp's help center says it can answer questions, teach you things and help you come up with ideas. WhatsApp's own Meta AI page adds photo edits, image creation, help with planning in groups and summaries of unread messages.

It is not available everywhere. WhatsApp says Meta AI is only in some countries and may not show up for you yet even if friends in your country have it. Supported languages include English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Hindi, Arabic, Indonesian, Tagalog, Thai and Vietnamese.
How to use Meta AI in WhatsApp: the basics

paragraphs.title: 1. Open the Meta AI chat
paragraphs.text: Start a chat with Meta AI from the Chats tab, then pick one of the suggested prompts or type your own and send it. The first time, you have to accept Meta's AI terms. On WhatsApp Web and Desktop you can continue a Meta AI chat you started on your phone.

paragraphs.title: 2. Or ask from the search bar
paragraphs.text: Type in the WhatsApp search bar. You get matching results from your own chats plus suggested questions for Meta AI. Pick a suggestion or send your question, and WhatsApp opens a Meta AI chat with the answer.

paragraphs.title: 3. Talk instead of typing
paragraphs.text: WhatsApp added voice chat with Meta AI in 2024: press the waveform button, ask out loud, and it talks back.

paragraphs.title: 4. Rate the answers
paragraphs.text: Hover over or long press an answer and choose Good response or Bad response. WhatsApp uses this feedback to improve answers.
WhatsApp says some AI answers may be inaccurate or inappropriate, so check anything that matters, such as dates, prices or health information, against another source.
Use Meta AI in a group chat

In a group, Meta AI only reads messages that mention @Meta AI, according to WhatsApp. Meta and WhatsApp also cannot add it to your personal chats on their own. Your normal messages and calls stay end-to-end encrypted.

paragraphs.title: 5. Ask with @Meta AI
paragraphs.text: Type @, choose Meta AI, then write your question, for example to settle a debate or suggest a meeting time that works across time zones. Everyone in the group sees the question and the answer.

paragraphs.title: Prompt 1: Plan a group meetup
paragraphs.text: @Meta AI We are 5 friends in [city]. Suggest 3 places for dinner on [day] under $30 per person, close to [neighborhood]. Keep it short.
Create and edit images

paragraphs.title: 6. Type imagine
paragraphs.text: In the Meta AI chat, type imagine followed by your description and send it. In any individual or group chat, type @, select imagine, then write the prompt. The picture appears in the chat.

paragraphs.title: 7. Change the picture
paragraphs.text: To change an image, reply to it with a new prompt. In a group, reply to the image, type @, choose Meta AI, then type imagine and the new instruction.

paragraphs.title: Prompt 2: A group icon
paragraphs.text: imagine a flat, colorful icon of [subject] for a group chat called [name], simple shapes, plain background

Meta AI can also work with your own photos. WhatsApp's blog says you can send a photo and ask about it, such as translating a menu or learning how to care for a plant, and ask Meta AI to edit it by adding, removing or changing something.

paragraphs.title: Prompt 3: Edit your own photo
paragraphs.text: Remove the people in the background of this photo and keep everything else the same.
Private options: Incognito Chat and summaries

In May 2026 WhatsApp announced Incognito Chat with Meta AI, built on its Private Processing technology. WhatsApp says these chats are processed in a secure environment Meta cannot access, are not saved and disappear by default. Meta said it would roll out over the following months, so it may not be on your phone yet.
Message summaries, where Meta AI sums up unread messages in a chat, also run on Private Processing. WhatsApp says this feature is off by default, and you choose whether to use it.
Turning off Meta AI in WhatsApp: what is possible

No. WhatsApp calls Meta AI optional, but its help center describes no setting that turns it off or removes it from the app, and guides from Android Authority, MSPowerUser and Kanal reach the same conclusion. If you never open the Meta AI chat or mention it, it does nothing.

What you can do: delete individual AI chats, and ask Meta to delete information you shared with Meta AI, as WhatsApp's help center describes. Deleting a chat removes it from your device, but Kanal notes it does not erase Meta AI's copy.

According to Kanal and MSPowerUser, sending /reset-ai in a Meta AI chat deletes Meta AI's copy of that conversation, and /reset-all-ais does it for every AI chat. Kanal says these commands do not work in Incognito chats.

For sensitive conversations, turn on Advanced Chat Privacy: tap the chat name, then Advanced Chat Privacy. WhatsApp says it stops people from exporting the chat, auto saving its media and using its messages in AI features.
For fewer pings, mute the Meta AI chat like any other chat, as Android Authority suggests. It stays in the app but stops asking for attention.
What is coming next

In July 2026 Meta said Meta AI, powered by its Muse Spark model, can now carry out multi step tasks such as making plans, research and daily briefings. Those features started in the Meta AI app and on meta.ai, and Meta said WhatsApp would get them later.

The honest verdict: Meta AI in WhatsApp is handy for quick questions, group planning and fast images without leaving the chat. It is weaker for anything you need to be exactly right, and you cannot remove it. Use the reset commands and Advanced Chat Privacy if you care about what Meta keeps.
